Use wrist view to bring the left camera between the fingers; advance and lower without changing arm configuration.
Close around the first camera, then lift gently and verify retention visually before transporting.
Camera appears retained. Carry it over the white basket with clearance and a closed gripper.
Release first camera inside white basket, then withdraw toward the remaining camera.
Approach remaining left camera from above with open fingers; visually check centering before closing.
Close on the second camera, then lift vertically to test retention before moving to white basket.
Camera retained in wrist view. Carry it over white basket with rim clearance, holding closed.
Release second camera in white basket, lift clear, and move toward the black figure in left workspace.
Center left fingers over the black figure's torso and descend gradually; keep right arm parked.

Replan after continuity rejection using smaller advances and slight lowering/forward tilt to position the retained figure inside blue basket.
Release black figure into blue basket and withdraw left; initialize right elbow-up approach to the white figure without crossing workspaces.
Withdraw left toward origin while bringing right above the white figure, maintaining separated workspaces and elbow-up continuity.
Lower and center right gripper over the white figure using the successful black-figure grasp height; finish parking the left arm.
Close on the white figure at the lower grasp height and lift vertically to verify retention.
White figure appears retained. Lift for rim clearance and carry toward the right half of blue basket, keeping the right arm on its own side.
Advance the retained white figure over blue basket, gently pitching forward to clear the front rim while preserving elbow-up reach margin.
Release white figure into blue beside black figure, then withdraw above the black wristband; keep left arm parked.
Approach black wristband with a downward-oriented open right gripper, matching its observed center and keeping clearance from the baskets.
Fine-align on the black band, close across its lower sides, and lift slightly to test retention.
Band remains ahead of the closed fingertips, so reopen and advance farther over it before another grasp.
Band is now centered between the fingers. Close across its sides and lift vertically to check retention.
Black wristband appears retained around the display. Carry it above the red basket with clearance and a closed gripper.
Release black wristband within red basket, then withdraw toward the remaining silver watch in the right workspace.
Approach the remaining silver watch from above, using the black-band grasp height and wrist feedback for final alignment.
Use wrist view to center the silver watch between the fingers, then close without translating.
Finish closing around the silver watch and lift vertically, checking that it stays between the fingers.
Silver watch slipped forward instead of staying in the grip. Reopen and approach its new visible position, aiming toward the solid watch body.
Adjust from wrist RGB toward the solid silver watch face, rather than closing into the hollow band.
Watch face is aligned with the closing tips. Pinch the solid case and lift slowly to verify retention.
Watch did not lift. Keep alignment over its case but reopen and lower the fingers farther to reach the solid body.
Close at the corrected lower height around the silver case, then lift steadily and inspect retention.
Silver case is now visibly retained. Raise for rim clearance and carry it over the red basket, holding closed.
Release silver watch beside black band in red basket, clear the rim, and begin returning to origin with both grippers open.
All six objects are visibly in their category baskets. Return the right arm toward origin with open grippers and continuous elbow-up motion.
Complete the right arm's return to its observed origin, keeping both grippers open while objects settle in their separate baskets.
